name: Samba
description: For those who love carnival, this paints its ideal to enjoy with friends and to show yourself off to your enemies meanwhile you are killing it inside maps.
interestingFacts: This paint was only available in the Brazilian and Spanish servers.
It was sold in a special bundle to celebrate the day of "Carnival" from February 24 to March 1st, 2017 for 24.99 USD.
The paint was again sold in a special bundle marking the "Carnival" occasion for 5.99 USD from the 10th - 13th of February 2018.

The paint is now only available to those players who purchased the bundles and whose game accounts were transferred from the Spanish and Brazilian servers to the European one during the migration on April 16, 2020.
The paint was issued as the Holiday paint for the carnival day celebrations on August 13th, 2021.
